description: Mutation protocol for writing OpenClaw human review decisions back into the FMEA draft artifacts.

top_level_fields.description: Original draft JSON path for traceability.

action_common_fields.description: Current scope of the row. Optional when row_key is globally unique.
Appended to the row-level review comment trail.

actions.purpose: Mark the row as fully reviewed and clear the current confirmation reasons.
Confirm the owning scope and optionally move the row to another scope worksheet.
Keep or remove a borrowed analogy row after expert review.
Override or complete S/O/D and recalculate RPN.
Write owner and target date back to the row and the 建议动作 sheet.
Frontend navigation action. The local apply script ignores it.

execution_notes: The current local apply script executes mutating actions in array order.
If the same row receives multiple actions, later actions see the earlier mutations.
Rows removed by confirm_reference_fit(decision=remove) disappear from reviewed Excel, JSON, and cards.
Rows that still keep unresolved confirmation reasons remain in 确认队列 after writeback.
